data.name: Rachmiel
data.gender_notes: Rachmiel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew words ‘racham’ (mercy) and ‘el’ (God). Rachmiel is the name of the angel of mercy, and in Christianity, it represents the compassionate and loving side of God. The name Rachmiel carries the meaning “God's mercy” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew. Parents who choose Rachmiel usually hope their child will grow to embody god's mercy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the boundless love and mercy of God.
data.etymology: Rachmiel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's mercy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rachmiel total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: רַחְמִיאֵל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: רַחְמִיאֵל הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'אל רחמים הוא לאהבה רבה'. הוא מורכב מ'רַחַם', שפירושו רחם או חמלה, ו'אל', שפירושו אלוהים. השם נגזר מהמילה 'רַחְמָה', שפירושו רחמים, ומוסיף את הסופית 'אל', שמדגישה את הקשר לאלוהים. השם רַחְמִיאֵל משמש לעתים קרובות בקהילות יהודיות וגם נוצריות, והוא מבטא את התקווה לאהבה וחמלה אלוהית.

in_greek.name: Ραχμιήλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ραχμιήλ είναι ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος רַחְמִיאֵל. Προέρχεται από τις εβραϊκές λέξεις 'רַחַם' που σημαίνει έλεος και 'אל' που σημαίνει Θεός. Στην ελληνική παράδοση, το όνομα Ραχμιήλ ερμηνεύεται ως 'Ο Θεός είναι το έλεος' ή 'Ο Θεός της συμπόνιας'. Το όνομα αυτό χρησιμοποιήθηκε στην Εκκλησία των Ανατολικών Ρυθών και αντανακλά την πνευματική σημασία της συμπόνιας και του ελέους.

in_latin.name: Rachmiel
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Rachmiel derivatur ex hebraeo רַחְמִיאֵל, quod significat 'Deus est misericordia' vel 'Deus misericors'. Compositum est ex 'רַחַם', quod est misericordia, et 'אל', quod est Deus. In traditione christiana, nomen Rachmiel significat gratiam et misericordiam divinam. Hoc nomen usitatum est in ecclesiis orientalibus et occidentalibus, et exprimit ideam de amore et misericordia Dei.

in_english.name: Rachmiel
in_english.meaning: God is mercy or God of compassion
in_english.long_meaning: The name Rachmiel originates from the Hebrew name רַחְמִיאֵל, which means 'God is mercy' or 'God of compassion'. It is derived from the Hebrew words 'רַחַם' (racham), meaning mercy or compassion, and 'אל' (El), meaning God. In Christian tradition, Rachmiel symbolizes divine love and mercy. The name is used across various Christian cultures, reflecting the spiritual significance of God's compassion and love for humanity. Historically, the name has been used in both Jewish and Christian communities, and it continues to be a meaningful choice for parents seeking a name that embodies spiritual values.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rachmiel carries significant cultural importance in Judaism and Christianity, as it is the name of an angel who embodies the essence of mercy and compassion in these respective traditions. This name transcends the boundaries of various religious communities and has gained popularity beyond traditional Jewish and Christian circles.
data.spiritual_significance: Rachmiel's name reflects the deep spiritual resonance of God's mercy and love, encompassing both the attribute of compassion and the power of God Himself. In a Christian context, the name Rachmiel encourages faith in the tender love of God, emphasizing the importance of praying for the mercy, compassion, and protection that comes from relying on our Heavenly Father. This spiritual significance transcends the person carrying the name, inspiring those who come into contact with it to turn towards God for solace, comfort, and grace.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Rachmiel means "God's mercy" in Hebrew. In Christian tradition, this name symbolizes the compassionate and loving nature of God towards His people. It is a reminder that no matter how dark the night may seem, God's mercy and love will always shine through.

historical_references.reference: Rachmiel is mentioned in the Talmud, a collection of Jewish teachings and commentary on the Hebrew Bible.

trends: used as a given name in Jewish communities
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Rachmiel remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.
